description: tools/impai/handicap_check.py's attackers for row 18, applied to impai-handicap.json with impai-handicap-economy.json, keeping every unit already there: two ARM Flea for the human seat, one 460 wu west of seat 1's start (8400, 4384) and one 500 wu south of seat 2's (4336, 304), each in a dry, flat box (heights 80 to 81, then 80 to 86, against the sea's 75). The check orders each to attack the computer seat's commander near it, a human seat's order that no stock planner replaces. The on-hit handler 0x406F80 (from the hit apply 0x489CE0 at 0x489DA2) runs the purge's type test 0x406FC3 for every hit with an attacker on a unit whose def has cancapture (+0x245 bit 12, the commander's key) and whose owner is an active record. The Flea's weapon is a beam (ARMFLEA_WEAPON: beamweapon 1, range 300, damage 8, reload 0.8 s) and outranges the CORE commander's laser (CORCOMLASER: range 200), so the Flea fires before it can be fired on, and at 10 damage a second it would need 300 seconds for a commander's 3000: no commander dies in the check, and with it the whole seat (the commander-death rule 0x486688).
